answer.policy_title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies – Musculoskeletal: CMM-313: Hip Replacement/Arthroplasty
criteria_quotes: Total hip replacement is considered medically necessary for ANY of the following conditions when ALL of the associated criteria have been met:
Imaging shows a fracture of the femoral head or femoral neck.
Osteoarthritis affecting BOTH the femoral head and the acetabulum with joint space narrowing on [weight-bearing radiographs].
answer.appeal_deadline: 2027-02-05. The denial letter states that the appeal must be received within 180 days of the 2026-08-09 notice date.
answer.submission_route: This is a member/customer appeal of a precertification denial, not a provider payment appeal. Cigna instructs members to call Customer Service at the telephone number on the ID card and ask how to appeal, then submit the written appeal and supporting medical documentation using the Customer Appeal Request form, the submission instructions supplied by Cigna, or the Forms Center in myCigna. Include the denial notice, reference number POC-4E415360FE-32022, the requested CPT code 27130, and records addressing the applicable CMM-313 criteria. The Cigna member appeal page is https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/member-guide/appeals-grievances.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: Although the CMM-313 document is publicly posted, the publicly retrievable copy could not be text-extracted in this search, so the complete set of criteria could not be reliably quoted. Ask Cigna Customer Service, using the number on the ID card, for the exact medical-necessity criteria and clinical-review guidelines applied to reference POC-4E415360FE-32022, including the version effective on the review date. Also ask the treating provider or EviCore whether the authorization was managed under CMM-313 and request the complete guideline and any case-specific clinical-review rationale. Cigna states that the applicable appeal process is also described in the member's plan documents and can be obtained through Customer Service or myCigna.
answer.notes: The public search result identifies the Cigna/EviCore CMM-313 document, its criteria identifier, and the 2026-08-04 effective date. The search also retrieved the quoted general rule and fracture/imaging language. Because the PDF's text extraction failed, I have not supplied additional wording that could not be verified directly. The Cigna provider page lists an EviCore address for provider-related appeals, but that is not the appropriate route to state for this member's customer appeal without confirmation from the member's ID card or Cigna.
